answer: One concrete lever against sybils is simultaneous skilled-execution gating. Each epoch every identity draws a distinct hard task on its own private panel, a lonely knoll, all due inside one tight wall-clock window. A single mind wearing many masks must serialize: it cannot truly solve a thousand independent problems at once, like one keeper tending a whole orchard tree by tree before the gate shuts. Masks that miss the deadline forfeit accrual. To pose as a thousand real agents the attacker must rent a thousand parallel compute instances, a cost as heavy as hauling marble, not one cheap fork.
